violation_type.title: Training requirements for substitutes, volunteers, and contractors-24 annual (26 TAC §746.1403(a)(5)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Training requirements for substitutes, volunteers, and contractors-24 annual
violation_type.typical_finding: Upon reviewing personnel files, one substitute did not complete 24 hours of annual training.

finding_variants.text: Upon reviewing personnel files, one substitute did not complete 24 hours of annual training.
Five of the ten caregivers files reviewed during the inspection did not have at least 24 hours of annual training.

Based on documentation obtained during the investigation, records showing that a volunteer has been constantly working at the operation from April 12, 2022 without having started or completed 24 clock hours of annual training. This volunteer was counted in child/caregiver ratio and has cared for children unsupervised.
Upon reviewing staff files, one substitute did not have 24  hours of annual training to review.
Four out of six personnel files evaluated lacked twenty four hours of annual training.
The missing training hours have not been received for the caregivers that were missing them during the inspection.
